# Unit Laser RX — artwork

Both observed U065 label faces are new high-resolution **reference redraws**, made from text and shapes using exact official U065 product photographs. No product photograph is cropped into a sticker. Final PNGs and their SHA-256 values, pixel dimensions and registrations are listed in [artwork.json](./artwork.json).

- Front: LASER / left arrow / BEAM, printed receiving diagram and LASER.RX blue footer; 2400 × 1680 px, 20 × 14 mm, center (0, 7, 3.8), front face.
- Back: LASER.RX, 140KHz~205KHz, PORT.B.I/O and IN / blank / 5V / GND pin blocks; 1944 × 1464 px, 16.2 × 12.2 mm, center (0, 7, −3.8), back face.

The blank block stays blank as photographed. The existing molded M5 mark remains source geometry. Typography, color, fine illustration strokes, label size and alignment are visual estimates from same-SKU photographs and native recesses; they are not production artwork or print measurements. No hidden package stamp, serial code or illegible fine text is fabricated. No additional printed face was identifiable in the retrieved exact-SKU references.

Only final PNGs, registration code and source descriptions are distributed here. Original design files, reference photographs and generating tools are excluded. Product marks and original printed designs retain their respective rights. `artwork:false` omits both labels independently for each model/module while leaving physical geometry unchanged.
